title: Gyrase cleavage sites
description: Trusted gyrase cleavage sites in the first 500 kb, with three drug treatments shown separately.
reference: E. coli W3110 with Mu insertion; author-provided E_coli_w3110_G_Mu reference
processing: Read the author repository trusted-site coordinate, N3E and Score tables. Keep every site at reported coordinate <500000 from Cfx, Oxo and Micro. Values are unchanged. The source calling script indexes genome arrays from zero and writes i+1 as the output GCS coordinate.
coordinateSystem: 1-based cleavage position in author W3110-Mu reference; no conversion to MG1655
limits: A 500 kb subset of the author reference, not the entire chromosome.
Cleavage trapping depends on the drug treatment; this is not an untreated activity map.
The motif score is not a binding affinity or a probability.
